turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why does my son have a zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come for thanks. Owen has a zero on a fifteen percent essay, and I want to know who decided that and on what basis.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells that software says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

Reliable. Your own procedure, section 4.3, says detection software doesn't establish a concern by itself. I have it printed.

Did anyone speak to my son before that zero went in, Hale?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Under which rule? Procedure 4.2 says a parent is called before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen saw that zero on his phone, in class.
I hope you understand my position.
My position isn't what we're here to discuss, Hale. What I have is a zero, a software score, and no call home. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm going to the principal's office.
